extraction.notes: 2027 rates and programs are posted. The camp-description page does not print a year beside its dates; its 2027 navigation, matching rates, and the explicitly dated 2027 day-camp page supply the season context. Navigator Wilderness Adventures retains June 21–26 while the other Session 2 programs list June 20–25; this may be an uncorrected older schedule. Registration is advertised as open now, but no dated opening announcement was found. The WORX Project registration page lists July weeks without a season year; no identifiable 2026 or 2027 summer offering was found, so it is not included. Canoeing and rock climbing appear as Pioneers weeks within Summer Day Camp rather than separate cards. The WORX programs page could not be read.
